newsitem.title: CHINA: Hwa Kay Thai says in stake sale talks.
newsitem.headline: Hwa Kay Thai says in stake sale talks.

text.p: Hwa Kay Thai Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it was in talk to sell a 10 to 15 percent stake in the company to a third party by placement of new shares.

"The company has commenced negotiation with a Hong Kong private company...in relation to the acquisition of the equity interest in the company in the range of 10-15 percent which may result in the issue of new shares of the company," the company said in a statement.
The company said the third party has extensive business connections in China.
"The negotiation is only at a preliminary stage," it said. "The major shareholders of the company will continue to retain control of the company."

The restaurant operator and "Puma" brand products distributor said the possible co-operation with the third party is a strategic move providing the company opportunitites to further strengthen its distribution business in China.
The company's shares were unchanged at HK$0.81 in early afternoon after hitting a high of HK$0.90.
